faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED
faq.subtitle: QUESTIONS
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Neon Horizon.
faq.q1: What platforms will Neon Horizon be available on?
faq.a1: Neon Horizon will launch on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. A cloud version is also in development.
faq.a2: Yes! The game features seamless drop-in/drop-out co-op for up to 4 players, as well as dedicated PvP zones within the open world.
faq.q3: What are the minimum system requirements?
faq.a3: We recommend at least an NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD equivalent for 1080p Low settings. For the full experience with Ray Tracing, an RTX 3060 or higher is recommended. Check our System Requirements page for details.
faq.a4: Neon Horizon is a premium title. Microtransactions are strictly limited to cosmetic items only. No pay-to-win mechanics.
faq.a5: Absolutely. Our 'Cyber-Forge' system allows for deep customization of your character's appearance, cybernetics, and skill trees.
faq.a6: Yes, the metropolis of 'Neo-Veridia' is a massive, contiguous open world with no loading screens between districts or interiors.
faq.a7: Yes, full cross-play and cross-progression are supported across all platforms from day one.
faq.a8: We are targeting a Holiday 2025 release. Sign up for our newsletter to get the latest updates on beta testing.
faq.a9: We have a robust post-launch roadmap including new districts, story expansions, and character classes.
faq.q10: How do I report a bug?
faq.a10: During the beta and after launch, you can report bugs directly through the in-game menu or via our official support portal.

privacy.title: PRIVACY
privacy.subtitle: POLICY

section1.title: 1. Data Collection
section1.content: At Neon Horizon Studios, we take your privacy seriously. We collect only the data necessary to provide you with the best gaming experience. This includes:

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
section2.content: Your data is used primarily to:
section2.item1: Authenticate your account and secure your progress
section2.item2: Match you with other players in multiplayer modes
section2.item3: Analyze game balance and improve features
section2.item4: Send important updates regarding service status (if opted in)

section3.title: 3. Data Protection
section3.content1: We employ industry-standard encryption (AES-256) to protect your personal information both in transit and at rest. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
section3.content2: You have the right to request a copy of your data or request its deletion at any time through our support portal.

section4.title: 4. Cookies & Tracking
section4.content: Our website uses essential cookies to maintain your session and preferences. We use limited analytics cookies to understand how users interact with our site to improve navigation and content.

privacy.contact: For any privacy-related inquiries, please contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@neonhorizon.game

gameInfo.title: ENTER THE
gameInfo.subtitle: SIMULATION
gameInfo.description: Neon Horizon is not just a game; it's a living, breathing digital ecosystem. In the year 2077, the boundaries between physical and digital reality have dissolved.

livingWorld.title: A Living World
livingWorld.description: Explore Neo-Veridia, a sprawling metropolis where every NPC has a routine, every action has a consequence, and the city itself evolves based on player choices.

yourMission.title: Your Mission
yourMission.description: As a rogue operative, you must uncover the truth behind "Project Aether." Infiltrate mega-corporations, hack secure networks, and decide the fate of humanity.

socialWarfare.title: Social Warfare
socialWarfare.description: Form alliances with other players, control districts, and engage in massive faction wars that reshape the political landscape of the city.
